newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Korona cleared to launch two new funds.
newsitem.headline: Polish Korona cleared to launch two new funds.

text.p: Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared Korona mutual funds company to launch two new funds for the equity and money market, KPW said in a statement.
Korona's deputy president Tadeusz Gacyk said the company, which has been running a balanced fund since August last year, had not yet decided on the launch date of the new funds.
"The date of launching the new funds will depend on market conditions," Gacyk told a news conference.
He said the money market fund would include short-term debt instruments such as treasury bills and commercial papers of up to one year of length.

Korona is a joint-venture between Creditanstalt Securities SA, a Polish broking subsidiary of Austria's Creditanstalt -Bankverein, and of Polish state-owned agriculture bank Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA.
